title: Kiểm tra và sửa luồng order của staff
rootCause: The staff order screen resolves restaurant scope twice, maps table fields/statuses inconsistently, and emits quick-action names that its caller does not handle. Persisted item adjustment mutations also bypass the shared order restaurant/permission guard, while payment requests reject cashier accounts that carry payment.write but not order.update.
